notes:
Account summary: Auriga Burst AI Labs (adtech) — high volume, highly bursty inference for personalization + reranking. Primary contact: CTO Maya Singh (was champion), now on extended leave; Eng lead Samir Patel in day-to-day. Decent interest but stalled after capacity questions and a vendor price/SLAs push.

Key constraints:
- Peak concurrency target: 750 qps sustained for 20s bursts, expected bursts up to ~2000 qps during flash promotions.
- Throughput target: ~500k tokens/min during high-load windows.
- Latency SLOs: 95th <= 250ms for reranking paths, 99th <= 600ms for chat flows.
- Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to commit if predictable unit economics and hard capacity guarantees.
- Security: require SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration, and US data residency.

Timeline / recent activity (CRM-style):
- 2025-10-20: Initial inbound; demo of Hosted API (Avery).
- 2025-11-05: Qualified; requested Dedicated pricing and capacity model (DEMO follow-up).
- 2025-11-18: POC kickoff — small-scale reranking tests on hosted. Linked: ff-20251012-auriga-demo.
- 2025-12-02: POC results: good quality, but observed queueing at 600 qps sustained; latency spikes at bursts. Notes: "can't risk queueing during campaigns" (CTO).
- 2026-01-07: Security review call; provided security FAQ + KMS diagram. Linked: ff-20260121-security-review.
- 2026-01-15: CompetitorX offered reserved cluster + guaranteed bursting at lower price; Auriga signaled preference but asked for Redwood SLA ramp plan.
- 2026-01-25: Internal budget freeze announced (finance). Champion (CTO) went on leave. Sales cadence quiet after.
- 2026-02-10: Follow-up demo re: Dedicated autoscaling and burst policies (SE Diego). Technical asked for hard queueing guarantees and per-route throttling controls.
- 2026-02-20: Last contact — Samir said "we're evaluating options; price + capacity still deciding factors."

Why stalled / closed-lost risk:
- Technical fit concern (primary): Auriga's traffic profile is extremely bursty; current POC indicated queueing and latency spikes under stress. They require hard guarantees for burst capacity or predictable fallback.
- Commercial: CompetitorX promised reserved capacity + lower per-token cost for the same commitment window.
- Org: Internal champion unavailable (CTO leave) and finance imposed hiring/budget freeze.
- Security: cleared for most items but wants explicit audit + KMS runbook before procurement.

What we tried:
- Scoped Dedicated POC with autoscaling rules and suggested batching/kv-cache tweaks.
- Benchmarked burst handling and provided kernel/quantization recommendation (Optimize team).
- Proposed cross-region fallback for overflow and canary rollouts to soften burst impact.
- Opened INFR-2145 to investigate queueing root cause; ENG provided tuning notes but customer wanted more deterministic SLA.

Next recommended actions (sales/SE):
- Offer a short-term reserved burst addon (commercial) to match competitor guarantee or explicit burst SLA pilot for 3 months.
- Schedule a technical deep-dive between Redwood infra leads and Auriga SREs to produce deterministic queueing mitigation plan (include request routing, shard isolation).
- Re-engage when CTO returns or escalate to VP engineering for prioritization.
- Keep security artifacts handy; push an executable runbook for KMS + audit logging to unblock procurement.

Stance: High strategic value (enterprise adtech with big ARR potential) but high risk. If budget/throttle guarantees not met, likely closed-lost to CompetitorX or delayed until budget re-open (Q3 cycle).
